summary.en: Present simple and present continuous: what each one is for, how to build them and how to choose.
summary.bs: Present simple i present continuous: za šta služi koje, kako se grade i kako birati.

concepts.youtubeQuery: present simple tense english grammar explained

bs.one: Present simple koristiš za navike, činjenice i stvari koje se stalno ponavljaju: I work, she lives, water boils.
bs.explain: Oblik: subjekat + osnovni glagol (I/you/we/they work), a za he/she/it dodaješ -s (he works). Pitanje s do/does, negacija s don't/doesn't. Često ide s riječima: always, usually, often, every day, on Mondays.
bs.example: 'I get up at 7. My husband works in a bank. The shop opens at 9.'
bs.why: Ovo je najčešće englesko vrijeme. Njime pričaš o sebi, svom poslu i rasporedu.
bs.mixup: Present simple NIJE za ono što se dešava baš sada. 'I read a book now' je pogrešno; treba 'I'm reading a book now'.

concepts.youtubeQuery: third person singular s english present simple rules

bs.one: U present simple, kad je subjekat he, she, it (ili jedna osoba/stvar), glagol dobija -s: she works.
bs.explain: Pravila pisanja su kao kod množine: poslije s, sh, ch, x, o dodaješ -es (watches, goes, does); suglasnik + y postaje -ies (study → studies). 'Have' postaje 'has'. U pitanjima i negaciji -s prelazi na does: 'Does he work?', 'He doesn't work'.
bs.example: 'My son plays football. He goes to training on Fridays and has a match on Sunday.'
bs.why: Ovo je najčešća greška stranaca. Kad pamtiš -s, odmah zvučiš tačnije.
bs.mixup: 'My friends lives' je pogrešno: 'friends' je množina (they), pa nema -s. -s ide samo uz jedninu.

bs.one: Present continuous koristiš za radnju koja traje baš sada ili ovih dana: I am working.
bs.explain: Oblik: am/is/are + glagol s -ing. 'I am eating', 'She is sleeping', 'They are waiting'. Pitanje: 'Are you working?' Negacija: 'I'm not working.' Pravopis: make → making (otpada e), run → running (udvaja se suglasnik), lie → lying.
bs.example: 'Don't call now, I'm driving.' 'This month I'm working from home.'
bs.why: Ovo je razlika koju bosanski nema: mi kažemo 'radim' za oboje. Engleski razlikuje 'I work' (inače) i 'I'm working' (sada).
bs.mixup: Neki glagoli stanja obično nemaju -ing: know, like, want, need, understand. 'I'm knowing' je pogrešno, treba 'I know'.

concepts.youtubeQuery: present simple vs present continuous difference

bs.one: Pitaj se: je li to navika ili nešto što se dešava sada? Navika = simple. Sada/privremeno = continuous.
bs.explain: Znakovi za simple: always, usually, every day, never, on Mondays. Znakovi za continuous: now, right now, at the moment, today, this week, Look!, Listen!. Ista radnja može ići u oba, zavisno od toga šta želiš reći.
bs.example: 'I usually drink tea, but today I'm drinking coffee.' 'He works in Zagreb, but this month he's working in Split.'
bs.why: Kad pogodiš vrijeme, slušalac odmah zna je li nešto stalno ili privremeno.
bs.mixup: 'What do you do?' pita za posao. 'What are you doing?' pita šta radiš upravo sada. Odgovori su potpuno različiti.

concepts.youtubeQuery: have vs have got english grammar

bs.one: Za posjedovanje engleski ima dva oblika istog značenja: 'I have a car' i 'I have got a car' (britanski, razgovorno).
bs.explain: S 'have': pitanje i negacija idu s do: 'Do you have a car?', 'I don't have a car'. S 'have got': 'Have you got a car?', 'I haven't got a car'. Za he/she/it: 'She has' ili 'She has got'. 'Have' se koristi i u izrazima gdje ne znači posjedovanje: have breakfast, have a shower, have fun.
bs.example: 'I've got two brothers.' = 'I have two brothers.' 'We have lunch at 1.'
bs.why: Ovo je jedan od najčešćih glagola, a britanski i američki engleski ga koriste malo drugačije.
bs.mixup: 'Have got' ne koristiš za radnje: 'I have breakfast at 8', ne 'I have got breakfast at 8'.

concepts.youtubeQuery: there is there are english grammar

bs.one: 'There is' i 'there are' kažu da nešto postoji ili se nalazi negdje. Odgovara bosanskom 'ima' ili 'postoji'.
bs.explain: 'There is' (there's) uz jedninu i nebrojive: There is a bank near here. There is some milk. 'There are' uz množinu: There are two banks. Pitanje: 'Is there…?', 'Are there…?' Negacija: 'There isn't…', 'There aren't any…'.
bs.example: 'Is there a pharmacy near here?' 'There are five people in my family.'
bs.why: Potrebno ti je da opišeš mjesto, sobu ili grad, i da pitaš za pravac.
bs.mixup: Ne prevodi 'ima' kao 'it has': 'U sobi ima krevet' je 'There is a bed in the room', ne 'It has a bed in the room'.

options.bs: She is work in a hospital.

explain.bs: 'Know' je glagol stanja i ne ide s -ing.
